row.notes: Loops while distance > 0: finds the current sector from g_Live_SectorEnds, and if the remaining distance does not reach the sector end calls Game_VehicleProgress_Update(self+0x28, new pos, sector, 1) and returns. Otherwise it stops if end_condition is met (type 0: lap count vs lap data +0x9c48, type 1: time limit vs +0x9c60), writes an estimated sector time with Game_Network_MOXOSQLittleBitRandomnessVariance via 0x14098c7f0 (or resets the 200-byte lap record with Sess_LapRecord_Construct when +0xb2d or a lap mismatch is set), moves progress to the next sector, queues a 0x30-byte message (vtable 0x145805480: entrant index, lap, sector, flags) on g_Game_MessageBus and calls Game_Network_VirtualSessionBroadcastNewLap when the sector index wraps. Good hook point for simulated (off-track) car lap and sector progress. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): agree.
